article.headline: Jacksonville State defeats LaGrange 123-59
article.description: — Jordan Stiemke had 17 points in Jacksonville State's 123-59 win over LaGrange on Monday night in a season opener for both teams.
article.story: JACKSONVILLE, Ala. -- — Jordan Stiemke had 17 points in Jacksonville State's 123-59 win over LaGrange on Monday night in a season opener for both teams. Stiemke went 6 of 11 from the field (4 for 8 from 3-point range) for the Gamecocks. Alijah Curry scored 16 points, going 5 of 6 (4 for 5 from 3-point range). Naas Cunningham had 14 points and shot 5 for 9, including 3 for 5 from beyond the arc. Brandon Battle led the way for the Panthers with 14 points. LaGrange also got 11 points and three steals from Austen Colton. Courtland Walker finished with eight points. Up next LaGrange: at Kennesaw State on Thursday. Jacksonville State: visits South Alabama on Thursday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
